Be Dino Status

Where the game is today, in plain words. Pictures are real screenshots from Roblox Studio.

NO-GO

Not ready for friends yet

The game itself works in our tests. What is missing is the publishing steps only you can do, and a test with two real players. The shortest way to GO:

  1. Pick the Roblox game for the test and publish it, then join it once with a second account so we know a friend can get in. you, about 30 min
  2. Check that the crystal packs are off sale in Creator Hub (2 minutes). When we looked today all six packs existed and were switched on. you
  3. Practise going back to the old version once (the rollback drill), so a bad update can be undone. you
  4. Play together with a second person for 10 minutes: runs, hatching, bites. Phone test only if phones may join. you plus one player
Not checked yet: a phone, two players at once, a published game, and sounds. Everything on this page was seen by one player in Studio on a computer. The code checks on our newest version passed today.
Code checks pass on newest version Seen in Studio: 1 player Not tested: 2 players Not tested: phone Not tested: published game

What works now

All of these were played in Studio today, one player, on the friends-test version.

Hatching eggs

Eggs open one at a time and show which dino you got and how rare it is.

Cracked eggs

Some eggs crack and give nothing. The screen says so in a friendly way.

Run complete

When a run ends you see your eggs, crystals and growth, and you are paid once.

Fusion

Six dinos of one kind turn into one new Gold dino. The chances are shown before you start.

Daily tasks

Small goals like "finish a run" give crystal prizes. Every prize paid exactly what it said.

Bite and health bars

The CHOMP button hurts a wild predator. It bites back, then gives up.

Fast travel

Buy it once for 500 crystals, then zip between the shops. A button brings you back.

Auras and trails

Each dino has its own glow and trail. Bought with crystals only, never real money.

Shop, nothing for Robux

The Eggs tile says "Coming soon". No Robux buttons anywhere in the screen.

Weather

Rain, thunderstorms and sunny spells come by themselves, with a bonus line for the player.

Golden Drumstick

A rare shiny snack that gives extra growth. Its name now shows when you eat it (fix waiting for a Studio look).
